children: In accordance with UKLR 6.4.9(2), Halma plc (the ‘Company') announces that Sharmila Nebhrajani OBE, Senior Independent Director of the Company, will be appointed as a non-executive director of Genus plc with effect from 1 January 2027.
A copy of this announcement, together with other information about Halma, may be viewed on its website:  www.halma.com
